name: [Update!] Survive The Hulk 😱
desc:
SURVIVE THE HULK

One player is chosen to become the Hulk. Everyone else must run, hide and survive until the round ends.

As the Hulk, hunt down every survivor using powerful punch combos, sprint attacks, a destructive thunder clap and the ability to locate hiding players. Smash through walls, doors, windows and furniture as the entire facility falls apart around you.

As a survivor, explore the facility, crawl through vents, break through glass and work together to escape. Unlock the Hulkbuster to fight back with heavy punches and repulsor blasts.

Can you survive the Hulk, or will you destroy everyone in your path?

🎮 PC, Mobile, Xbox and PlayStation

⭐ Like and favourite the game for more updates!

#Hulk #Scary #Survive #Killer #Destruction #Destroy #Escape #Horror #Survival #Multiplayer #Hulkbuster

llm.loop: round starts -> one player becomes the Hulk -> survivors run, hide and escape through a destructible facility while the Hulk smashes and hunts -> round ends -> repeat
llm.objectives: as survivor, stay alive until the round ends or escape; as the Hulk, find and eliminate every survivor
llm.progression: unclear; cosmetic skins and Hulkbuster ability bought with Robux
llm.instructions: one player is the Hulk; everyone else runs, hides, crawls through vents and works together to escape; unlock the Hulkbuster to fight back
unique: full environment destruction in a 1-vs-all chase
survivors can buy a Hulkbuster to fight back
